mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recharge(username, amount, payment_method, status, order_no, create_time, remark) VALUES(#{username}, #{amount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{status}, #{orderNo}, NOW(), #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, amount, payment_method, status, order_no, create_time, update_time, remark FROM recharge WHERE username = #{username} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 50
